$comment: Standing platform test checklist — area ledger. Hand-edited, append-only; validated by scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs (pnpm check:platform-checklist). Authoring rules: docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md · execution protocol: RUNNER.md.
title: Records, lists, detail pages, forms

items.title: Create → read → update → delete a record through the console UI
steps: on a seeded showcase object, create a record through the New form
open its detail page; edit a field; save
delete it from the row/detail actions
after each mutation, re-read the row over the data API

acceptance.clause: each UI mutation is reflected in the server row (the API read is the oracle, not the grid repaint)
acceptance.verify: GET /api/v1/data/<object> after each step shows the created values, the edit, and finally the row gone

acceptance.clause: the list view reflects the changes after refresh without stale rows
acceptance.verify: post-delete screenshot of the list shows the row absent

items.title: Master + line items save as one atomic batch

requires: a master-detail pair with an inline child grid (e.g. expense report + lines)

steps: edit the master and several child lines in one form session, save once
repeat with one child line made deliberately invalid, save

acceptance.clause: the happy-path save lands master + children in one batch request
acceptance.verify: the save issues a single batch call (not N sequential writes); all rows readable afterwards

acceptance.clause: a failing child aborts the WHOLE save — no partial writes
acceptance.verify: after the failed save, API reads show master and siblings unchanged
acceptance.evidence: API reads proving no row moved

negative: the invalid-child case above IS the negative side — it must not partially commit

items.title: Related lists page on the server, never fetch every child row

requires: a parent record with more children than one page (e.g. Northwind account with 26 contacts)

steps: open the parent detail page's related list
click next-page; capture the data requests

acceptance.clause: paging issues server-side $top/$skip requests scoped by the parent filter; the full child set is never fetched
acceptance.verify: page 1 = top=N&filter=[parent]; next page = top=N&skip=N; no request without top
acceptance.evidence: the captured request URLs + the pager reading 'page 2 of M'

history.change: initial import from the #3358 evidence run

items.title: Action params render their real widgets, not text inputs

requires: the Action Param Gallery action on the Field Zoo row menu

steps: run the gallery action; wait for the dialog to render (screenshot first)
read each param's rendered control from the dialog DOM

acceptance.clause: each param type maps to its real widget: date→input[type=date], color→input[type=color], richtext→editor, select→picker, file/image→input[type=file] with accept/multiple as declared, autonumber→read-only server-assigned
acceptance.verify: after screenshot confirms render, enumerate controls and match the declared param types; accept/multiple must be real DOM attributes

negative: maxSize is enforced in JS, not as a DOM attribute — do NOT claim it from attribute absence; it needs an oversized-upload attempt to verify

history.change: initial import from #3358, keeping its maxSize caveat as a negative-side note

items.title: Confirm stays disabled while a file param is still uploading
steps: open an action dialog with a file param; start a real upload large/slow enough to catch mid-flight
attempt to confirm while the upload is in progress

acceptance.clause: the Confirm control is actually disabled mid-upload and enables on completion — proven by catching a real upload in flight, not by reading the helper label
acceptance.verify: during the in-flight window the button carries disabled state and clicking issues no request; after completion the confirm succeeds
acceptance.evidence: mid-flight screenshot + network trace showing no premature submit

source: #3358 §4 ('leaving it unticked on the strength of a label')

history.change: initial — codifies the #3358 refusal to tick from a label into the oracle itself

items.title: CSV import: GBK decode, required-field hint, legacy-fallback notice
steps: run the pinned unit suites (they feed real GBK bytes and assert the exact decode, the disabled-Next hint, and the visible degrade notice)
optionally spot-check the wizard visually past the native file picker

acceptance.clause: all three clauses are pinned by targeted tests in objectui

source: #3358 §4 (ticked on test evidence — the native file picker hand-off is deliberately not automated)
